summary: Submitted a research submission carrying sourced feedback on candidate 0a6d446a083a42cf91e99726f577eaea, which now holds a confirmed implementation violation through direct check artifact 3b256fe6f42b4154b75d4d2ec02e27bf (execution 452a068dbfa1488ea15bc730a0f1e7bd, correspondence no_issue_found).
